turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest, do not speak so. The Lord will provide for all of us. Our son will take care of the fool in the court and our family will be well. You have given us a good life, and your legacy will live on through our children.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I see your smile, husband, and it gives me comfort. But remember my words, for they come from a heart full of love and care.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, do not worry. Our family is strong, and we will continue to be so. Your wishes will be fulfilled, and our son will marry soon, bringing joy and prosperity to our home.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad to hear your words, Wang Lung. But let us not delay, for time is not on our side. We must ensure my son's marriage is arranged swiftly.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry. Father and I will see to it that everything is arranged as you wish. We want to make you happy.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Your heart is strong, my love. Rest assured, we will make your every wish come true. The Lord will guide us, and your son will be married soon.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, we will start making the arrangements right away. Please rest and do not worry about anything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, my son. And Wang Lung, let us not wait. The sooner we act, the better it will be for all of us.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my heart is at peace knowing you are surrounded by love. We will move swiftly, but do not push yourself. Rest now, and let us handle the details.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will take care of all the arrangements, sir, ma'am. Please rest easy.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my dear, let us trust in the Lord's plan. He will provide for our family as He always has.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I understand your words, but please, let us not delay any longer. I see the shadows that follow you, and I do not wish for you to shoulder this burden alone.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest. Father and I will ensure everything is done according to your wishes.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, I am grateful for your devotion. But please, let us not wait. I must see your marriage before I leave this world.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I understand your wish. I will speak with Father and the maid about the arrangements immediately.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I thank you, my son. And now, let us gather the necessary items for the wedding and see to it that nothing is left to chance.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Yes, my lady. I will prepare everything as you wish.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, do not worry. We will have your wish fulfilled soon. Rest now, and let us handle the preparations.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, my love. But rest assured, I will oversee the preparations to ensure they are done right.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, you must rest. Your health is our greatest concern. The eldest son and the maid will take care of everything.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
